question: Two chords, AB and CD, are equal in length and are at a distance of 10 cm from the center of a circle. If the radius is 26 cm, what is the length of AB?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The perpendicular from the center bisects the chord, forming a right-angled triangle with the radius.

Half of the chord length = √(Radius² − Distance²)

Half chord = √(26² − 10²) = √(676 − 100) = √576 = 24 cm.

Total length of chord AB = 2 × 24 = 48 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**
